title: Error Budgets Are
subtitle: A budget should change what the team does next, not just what the dashboard shows

panels.heading: Budget Healthy
panels.caption: Burn is slow and plenty of budget remains for the window
panels.note: Spend surplus deliberately: riskier releases, migrations and chaos drills

panels.heading: Burn Accelerating
panels.caption: Short and medium burn-rate windows both cross their thresholds
panels.note: Pre-agreed gates stop the pipeline by default instead of starting a debate

panels.heading: Budget Exhausted
panels.caption: Brakes engage and reliability work takes priority over features
panels.note: If no decision ever changes when the budget moves, it is only a dashboard

strip_caption: Measure what users notice, set a target, and let the remaining budget drive policy
